C-FRESHNESS orthogonality holds on localhost/distributed at delta=0.15 (r ~0.04, CI upper <0.15) yet all product gates fail on distributed session-store non-replication (C1 TN 0.667) and threshold tautology. C-PARAM-INHERIT regressed to MEASUREMENT_INVALID after synthetic POCs; no live-browser parameterized inheritance demonstrated despite WebArena census validated (192 tasks, 49 intents, dup 0.9479, AX 0.9). C-PRODUCT-ECON REJECTED after 6 vacuous extrapolations (logistic saturates at 0.5654 = constant null). C-WEB-DYNAMICS HYPOTHESIS after 59 synthetic-dominated tests: Bayesian DM K=12 first to pass C1+C3 on synthetic (168-643 nats, p 0.0005) but log BF -10 to -15 on real TodoMVC (M0 favored), PMI/TV/KDE intrinsic bias ~0.41-bit floor, Gate0 SPAs unavailable (substrate_unavailable). C-CROSSSITE/C-LLM-INHERIT census validated but website-holdout overlap unproven (Mind2Web 73 vs 137 divergence). Highest marginal value is direct end-to-end live tests of parameterized family-holdout inheritance and delta-repair with real LLM+Playwright, not another localhost divergence or decompression sweep.
